label: TenderNed
terms_note: Dutch government open platform; keyless public API; bids need eHerkenning login.

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** for search (public TNS API). Lane `assist` → **api for search**. Confidence high.

endpoints.notes: content[]: publicatieId, publicatieDatum, typePublicatie{code,omschrijving}, aanbestedingNaam, opdrachtgeverNaam, procedure, sluitingsDatum

reference.limits: - Open platform; bids via eHerkenning in TenderNed. - Dutch government open platform; keyless public API; bids need eHerkenning login.

adapter.terms: TenderNed publicatie Webservice (TNS), listed on data.overheid.nl (licence CC-0, data owner PIANOo): 'houd er rekening mee dat deze Webservice zonder voorafgaande kennisgeving gewijzigd kan worden'. Keyless JSON; bids are submitted on TenderNed with eHerkenning, not through this service.

search_postings.note: GET /publicaties?page (0-based)&size: the latest TenderNed publications, newest first, as listed on data.overheid.nl ('publicatie Webservice (TNS)'). The dataset page documents only page and size, so `query`, `category` and `min_budget` are ignored; filter the rows yourself. Rows carry publicatieId, publicatieDatum, aanbestedingNaam, opdrachtgeverNaam, typePublicatie {code, omschrijving} (e.g. AAO aankondiging, AGO gegunde opdracht), procedure, typeOpdracht (D/L/W) and a link to the notice page (in raw). No budget is published in the list.

not_offered.me: The TNS webservice is keyless; there is no account endpoint.
not_offered.get_posting: The only documented per-notice call is the XML API GET /publicaties/{publicatieId}/public-xml (https://www.tenderned.nl/info/swagger/), which 'is beveiligd via basic authentication' with credentials issued by functioneelbeheer@tenderned.nl and returns TED-schema XML; the keyless TNS documents only the list.
not_offered.submit_bid: Tenders are submitted on the TenderNed platform with eHerkenning; neither the TNS nor the XML API accepts submissions (https://www.tenderned.nl/info/swagger/ has a single GET operation).
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API is published (data.overheid.nl lists only the platform, RSS, TNS and XML API).
not_offered.credits: Free, keyless service; no quota endpoint.
